message.jaymospowers.pod.scrap: The %1$s was too far gone; only scrap comes off.
message.jaymospowers.pod.keel_last: The %1$s is set down. Nothing is left of the pod but its frame.
research.jaymospowers.pod_canopy.text: Glass, drawn up through amethyst and quartz until it holds no seam at all. Whatever wears it will sit under it and look out.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod.worn: Worn. A salvage rack mends it.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod.world_part.1: Grade I. Sneak and use it on a finished pod.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod.world_part.2: Grade II. Sneak and use it on a finished pod.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod.world_part.3: Grade III. Sneak and use it on a finished pod.
message.jaymospowers.pod.finished: The hull rings true. The beacon lights.
message.jaymospowers.pod.unfinished: She isn't finished. A hammer on the hull seals her.
message.jaymospowers.pod.grade_max: There is nothing left to mend on her.
message.jaymospowers.pod.grade_next: That isn't what she wants next. Grade %1$s wants the %2$s.
message.jaymospowers.pod.grade_unfinishe: Finish her with a hammer first.
message.jaymospowers.pod.wreck_bare: There is nothing more here for you.
message.jaymospowers.pod.wreck_salvaged: You pull what can be saved out of the wreck.
message.jaymospowers.pod.hard_landing_so: She comes down hard, but the hull holds.
message.jaymospowers.salvage.hint: A hammer in one hand and %1$s in the other would mend it.
message.jaymospowers.salvage.sound: It is sound. Take it off the rack.
message.jaymospowers.salvage.needs: Mending takes %1$s in your other hand.
message.jaymospowers.salvage.full: There is a part on the rack already.
jei.jaymospowers.salvage.how: Lay the worn part on the rack, then strike it with a hammer: %1$s blows mend it.
jei.jaymospowers.salvage.metal: The first blow uses one of the metal, held in the other hand.
jei.jaymospowers.salvage.scrap: Sneak and strike to break it up for scrap instead.
jei.jaymospowers.mending.how: Sneak and use it on a finished pod, grade by grade.
jei.jaymospowers.mending.grade.1: Grade I: a trip that burns 3 fuel or more burns 1 less.
jei.jaymospowers.mending.grade.2: Grade II: a second seat for a passenger.
jei.jaymospowers.mending.grade.3: Grade III: a hard landing shakes no part loose.
jei.jaymospowers.mending.from: The prize for settling %1$s (shown: the keel that remembers the grade).
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.story.8: "The raiders fly their pods stripped. No door in the hull, no glass in the cockpit. They don't care what shows, only that it goes."
